verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own business-account page claims you can 'Open a Business Account In Minutes', which speaks directly to fast founder onboarding. However, this is only a marketing headline. There is no documentation of the full onboarding flow (KYC/KYB review, verification timelines, time to a funded, operational account), so 'fully onboard in about a week' is asserted rather than evidenced. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end onboarding steps and verification timelines, evidence that full activation (not just account opening) completes within a week, and independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
